mapper.insert: insert into users(user_id, first_name, last_name, gender, height) values(#{userId}, #{firstName}, #{lastName}, #{gender}, #{height}) as params on duplicate key update first_name = params.first_name, last_name = params.last_name, gender = params.gender, height = params.height

insert into users_auth(user_id, mailaddress, password_hash) values(#{userId}, #{mailaddress}, #{passwordHash}) as params on duplicate key update user_id = params.user_id, mailaddress = params.mailaddress, password_hash = params.password_hash
mapper.delete: delete u, ua, w, wg from users u left join users_auth ua on u.user_id = ua.user_id left join weight w on u.user_id = w.user_id left join weight_goal wg on u.user_id = wg.user_id where u.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select u.user_id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.gender, u.height, ua.user_id as auth_id, ua.mailaddress, ua.password_hash from users u left join users_auth ua on u.user_id = ua.user_id where u.user_id = #{userId}
